summary: The investigation did not obtain sufficient evidence to definitively attribute the 500 errors to a bug introduced in order-service v2.14.0 (H1). While the deployment and NullPointerException logs strongly correlate, the root cause—whether a code bug or missing marginProfile data—remains ambiguous. Immediate mitigation and targeted data collection are required to resolve the uncertainty.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Bug introduced in order-service deployment v2.14.0 causing NullPointerException
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The order-service deployment v2.14.0 added a margin check for futures & options orders. The new code fails when marginProfile is null, throwing a NullPointerException that propagates as HTTP 500 responses.

causal_chain.claim: order-service was deployed version v2.14.0 at 12:10 UTC
deployment included refactor of order validation and addition of a margin check
margin check accessed a null marginProfile, causing NullPointerException
NullPointerException resulted in HTTP 500 responses for POST /v1/orders

assumptions: The NullPointerException is directly caused by the new margin check code rather than missing data or downstream failures.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Missing margin profile data in ledger‑db leads to NullPointerException
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The new margin‑check logic expects a marginProfile record for each account. For some accounts (e.g., 99733) the record is absent in ledger‑db, so the code receives null and throws a NullPointerException, causing HTTP 500 errors.

causal_chain.claim: ledger‑db lacks marginProfile rows for certain accounts
order-service margin‑check queries ledger‑db and receives null
Null marginProfile triggers NullPointerException in order-service

assumptions: The marginProfile data is stored in ledger‑db and was not populated for the affected accounts.
No recent DB schema changes or migrations introduced this gap.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Feature‑flag/configuration change enabled margin check for derivative orders
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A recent configuration or feature‑flag change turned on the newly added margin check for futures & options orders, exposing a code path that throws a NullPointerException when marginProfile is missing, leading to HTTP 500 errors.

causal_chain.claim: A config/feature‑flag change enabled the margin check for derivative orders
Enabled code path accessed marginProfile which was null, causing NullPointerException

assumptions: A config or feature‑flag change occurred around 12:10 UTC (not captured in the findings).
The margin check code itself is correct; the failure is due to it being executed unexpectedly.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Pricing‑engine returns null margin data causing order-service failure
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The order-service calls pricing‑engine to obtain margin information. A recent (unrecorded) issue in pricing‑engine returns null, which the order-service does not handle, leading to a NullPointerException and HTTP 500 errors.

causal_chain.claim: pricing‑engine returned null marginProfile for the request
order-service attempted to use the null value, causing NullPointerException

assumptions: Pricing‑engine behavior changed without a deployment (e.g., data issue or external dependency failure).

facts.statement: Order-service was deployed version v2.14.0 at 2026-03-03T12:10:00Z, introducing a margin‑check refactor.
Error‑rate metric spiked from ~0.2% to >11% at 12:10 UTC, reaching ~18% shortly after.
First logged 500 error occurred at 2026-03-03T12:12:44Z with message "order rejected with 500: java.lang.NullPointerException: marginProfile is null for account 99733".
All 15 error log entries between 12:12 and 12:19 share the same NullPointerException pattern on marginProfile being null.
No configuration or feature‑flag changes were recorded for order-service (or any service) between 12:00 and 12:20 UTC.
CPU and memory usage remained stable (≈40% CPU, ≈60% memory) during the error onset.
No error logs containing the endpoint path "/v1/orders" were found before 12:00 UTC.

assumptions: The NullPointerException originates from the order-service code path that accesses marginProfile.
The marginProfile data is expected to be present in ledger‑db for all accounts; its absence would cause a null value.
No hidden or undocumented feature‑flag change enabled the new margin‑check logic around 12:10 UTC.
Downstream services (pricing‑engine, exchange‑gateway, ledger‑db) behaved normally and did not introduce the null value.

timeline.event: Baseline: No /v1/orders error logs; system operating normally.
order-service deployed version v2.14.0 with margin‑check refactor.
First 500 error logged: NullPointerException on marginProfile for account 99733.
15 additional 500 errors with identical NullPointerException pattern.
CPU and memory remain stable; no config/flag changes recorded.

recommended_actions.action: Rollback order-service to the previous stable version (v2.13.x) to immediately stop the 500 errors.
recommended_actions.rationale: The deployment of v2.14.0 coincides with the error spike; rolling back removes the new margin‑check code pending further analysis.

recommended_actions.action: Query ledger‑db for marginProfile rows for account 99733 and a sample of recent accounts; verify whether the data is missing.
recommended_actions.rationale: Determines if the NullPointerException is caused by absent DB data (supporting H3) or by code that fails to handle null values (supporting H1).

recommended_actions.action: Retrieve the full stack trace for the NullPointerException logged at 12:12:44 UTC.
recommended_actions.rationale: Identifies the exact code path (e.g., DB query vs pricing‑engine call) that produced the null marginProfile, discriminating between H1, H2, and H3.

recommended_actions.action: Audit feature‑flag and configuration change logs for order-service and its downstream dependencies for the window 12:00‑12:20 UTC, ensuring no hidden changes were missed.
recommended_actions.rationale: Addresses the gap that could support H2 (undocumented flag enablement).

recommended_actions.action: Add defensive null‑check for marginProfile in the order-service margin‑check code and emit a clear error metric if missing.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents future NullPointerExceptions regardless of data quality, improving resilience.

recommended_actions.action: Enhance observability: capture full stack traces, DB connection‑pool metrics, request‑rate metrics, and ensure configuration change events are reliably logged.
recommended_actions.rationale: Fills the identified gaps (missing stack trace, DB metrics, config change visibility) to enable faster root‑cause analysis in future incidents.

data_gaps: No verification of whether marginProfile rows exist for account 99733 in ledger‑db (cannot confirm H3).
Full stack trace for the NullPointerException was not captured, limiting insight into the exact code path (affects H1, H2, H3).
Configuration/feature‑flag change logs returned zero entries; completeness of logging cannot be guaranteed (affects H2).
DB connection‑pool usage and request‑rate metrics were not collected, leaving open the possibility of resource‑related contributors.
what_would_change_the_conclusion: If the ledger‑db query shows that marginProfile for account 99733 (and other affected accounts) is missing, the primary cause would shift to a data‑availability issue (supporting H3).
If the full stack trace reveals that the NullPointerException originates directly from the new margin‑check code without a preceding null check, it would confirm H1 as the root cause.
If audit logs uncover a hidden feature‑flag enablement for the margin‑check at ~12:10 UTC, H2 would become the leading explanation.
